notes: IMPORTANT - this update is different, follow these 4 steps once: 1) Before updating, open Dashboard - Backup - Export backup. 2) Extract the new zip into a NEW folder (for example Documents\JobVayu). Do NOT copy it over your old JobVayu folder. 3) Open chrome://extensions - Load unpacked - select the new folder. 4) In the new JobVayu, open Dashboard - Backup - Import backup: your profile, companies, saved emails and license key all come back. Then remove the old JobVayu. From 1.7.0 on, every future update keeps everything automatically.
